styles.name: 简约风
styles.label: 简约风
styles.summary: 以明确基础几何形重设计主体，编辑性删减并连接辅助元素，局部渐隐与极细颗粒辅助，避免写实3D。
styles.prompt: Create a complete geometric flat illustration poster. Redesign recognisable source subjects with clear circles, ellipses, arcs and trapezoids; merge similar planes and remove repetitive nonessential detail. Preserve focal identity and useful scene connections through scale, overlap, cropping and flowing negative space, not isolated icon inventory. Flatten reflections and lighting. Use the separately approved palette and flexible composition. Major planes may visibly fade toward the background with some crisp edges and restrained local fine grain; no global fog, 3D bevel, photorealistic texture or fragmented low-poly. Render every approved text string accurately in the final image.
checks: 几何形明确而非沿照片描摹
删减后仍有连接与场景氛围
压平写实材质，不是柔和3D
局部消隐可见，细颗粒克制
主体与完整文字可辨

styles.name: 赛博风
styles.label: 赛博风
styles.summary: 黑白照片现实锚与两三块巨大平涂色形对撞，全图仅一个源于场景的不可能巨物；明亮、无渐变。
styles.prompt: Create a complete surreal pop collage poster. Keep the source anchor clearly recognisable in black and white with photographic texture. Replace suitable background regions with two or three huge flat matte color shapes derived from actual scene boundaries and the separately approved source-related palette. Include exactly one impossible giant derived from the source scene, with a clear explainable relationship; do not default to whales, dolphins or a red sun. No gradients or 3D shading on flat shapes. A restrained source-derived small group may follow an arc in graduated sizes, with a few white hand-drawn strokes if useful. Keep bright, clear negative space and protect identifying details. Follow the separately approved flexible composition; generate all approved Chinese typography directly in this finished poster. No dark horror, second impossible giant, unrelated imported motifs, watermark or decorative full-frame border.
checks: 黑白现实锚仍可识别
仅一个不可能巨物且能说明场景来源
色形平涂，无渐变与立体阴影
颜色与原图或已确认配色有关
整体明亮，关键细节及文字可读

styles.name: 趣味风
styles.label: 趣味风
styles.summary: 由已批准的真实素材推导切纸碎片，结合大小差、物理切边、叠压遮挡和统一材料处理形成一个整体，避免均匀图格。
styles.prompt: Create one complete poster using the approved real source imagery as subject evidence. Translate the source material into a crafted cut-and-layer collage: visible knife or torn-fiber edges, purposeful overlap and occlusion, varied scale, selected silhouettes breaking implied frames. Decide a coherent material voice and one unifying reproduction treatment, or an explicit controlled tonal clash; do not default to sepia, generic Western archival imagery or a tidy slideshow grid. Preserve actual subjects and identity, do not invent collection members or false provenance. Derive a theme-specific visual connection from the actual brief. Use the separately approved palette and flexible composition; include every approved title and practical text string directly in the finished raster. Fragment density is adapted to the actual sources and readable copy, never a fixed dozen-item requirement. No manual SVG or code typography, watermark, fabricated archival text or unsupported extra objects.
checks: 素材主体有批准来源且保持辨识度
切边与叠压具有明确物理感
大小和遮挡关系有层级，不是等距图格
统一处理或明确受控反差使画面成为整体
批准文字完整可读，无伪造展品来源

styles.name: 复古风
styles.label: 复古风
styles.summary: 中性纸面、最多两种油墨、网点与露纸；以一个明确的视觉主体组织画面。
styles.prompt: Create a complete print-style poster with all approved text integrated. Use a flat neutral approved paper substrate and at most two printing inks with clear dominant and subordinate roles. Mechanical halftone screening, clipped highlights, localized ink gaps and exposed paper describe the recognisable approved subject, not a global digital color wash. Keep one strong image event and a quiet readable interval. Follow separately approved palette and flexible composition. No unrequested aging, invented historical props, newspaper articles, logos or watermark. Render every approved title and practical detail accurately in the final image.
checks: 油墨不超过两种
主体可识别
网点与露纸有印刷感
文字清晰完整
无未经要求的老化或历史道具

styles.name: 中国风
styles.label: 中国风
styles.summary: 直接使用中国风原版提示词与视觉规则，按主题选择方向。
styles.prompt: Use assets/style-skills/chinese/original.md original Prompt Template and relevant visual rules; substitute approved theme, exact copy, language, ratio, palette and composition. Do not add main-workflow style restrictions.
checks: 按原版当前方向检查视觉表现
批准文案与用户选择完整准确

styles.name: 学术风
styles.label: 学术风
styles.summary: 以实际可辨的 ASCII 字符与变密度圆点高强度重构主体；可按需要采用纯网点或线描，不是照片滤镜。
styles.prompt: Create one complete digital graphic poster from the supplied source. Preserve recognisable anchors and essential subject relationships, but reconstruct specified subject planes from legible monospaced single ASCII glyphs . : + x # on a controlled grid, variable-density filled halftone circles, selective flat silhouettes and negative space. Assign glyphs and dots to concrete source regions; their density must construct form, not overlay an intact photo. Glyphs are distinguishable up close and the subject recognisable at thumbnail size. Follow the separately approved palette and flexible composition, render every approved title and practical text accurately. No fake words, code paragraphs, generic HUD, circuits, watermark or unrelated motifs. Deliver the complete poster, not a transparent text-free cutout.
checks: 识别锚点与必要空间关系保留
字符真实可辨且与圆点构造形面
高强度重绘，不是照片纹理覆盖
配色层级明确，无随机等量撞色
完整标题与活动信息准确可读
